result.title: Symmetry Fingerprinting with Geometric Learnable Invariants Transformers
result.summary: Geometric deep learning has made available a large variety of structurally equivariant neural network architectures, meaning a particular transformation of their input causes a predictable transformation of their output. But structural equivariance is a very strong inductive bias that can limit performance if chosen poorly. In contrast, choosing an architecture with low geometric bias necessitates data augmentation to obtain correct behavior; extending the training process. We propose a novel neural network architecture that is soft equivariant; we select a set of symmetry groups and during training the network will become equivariant only to those symmetry groups that are appropriate given the training data. After training we can inspect the network to obtain a symmetry fingerprint that will tell us exactly which symmetries ended up being relevant and to what degree. We show how our architecture and the fingerprinting process work in the case of an image classification task.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种软等变网络架构：训练时让网络自动只对数据支持的对称群保持等变，训练后读出「对称性指纹」以表明哪些对称性相关及其程度，并在图像分类任务上演示该流程。
AI.relevance_reason: 其可学习的对称性选择与表示几何诊断思路，可能为刻画 VLM 内部视觉状态中保留的几何与任务必要结构提供度量线索，但尚无多模态推理实验，指纹能否迁移到推理状态可供核查。
